   - Defined `OpType` string enum with supported operations: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`.

   - Added ULID helpers for batches and entry IDs: [`NewBatchID`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L52), [`NewBatchIDWithTime`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L57), [`NewEntryID`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L62), [`NewEntryIDWithTime`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L71), [`NewBatch`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L80), and [`NewBatchWithTime`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L94).

2. **Op File I/O ([`internal/core/ops/writer.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/writer.go), [`internal/core/ops/reader.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/reader.go))**:
   - [`Writer.Write`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/writer.go#L24): Writes validated batches as indented JSON to `.memory/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json`, creating monthly directory partitions with `os.MkdirAll`.
   - [`Reader.ReadBatch`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/reader.go#L33): Reads and unmarshals single batch files, performing full schema validation.

3. **Op Log Iterator ([`internal/core/ops/iterator.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go))**:
   - [`Reader.Iterate`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L68): Returns `iter.Seq2[*OpBatch, error]` walking month directories in chronological order and files within each month by ULID order.
   - [`Reader.IterateAfter`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L77): Incremental iteration filtering batches strictly after a specified `afterBatchID`.
   - [`Reader.IterateBefore`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L87): Resolves commit timestamps via `git log -1 --format=%cI <commit>` and filters batches strictly before the cutoff timestamp for time-cut replays.
   - Provided pull iteration support via [`Iterator.Next`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L44) / [`Iterator.Close`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L58).

4. **Validation ([`internal/core/ops/validate.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go))**:
   - [`ValidateOp`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L10): Enforces required fields per op type (`add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`) with clear error messaging for missing or malformed fields.
   - [`ValidateBatch`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L170): Validates batch version, ID, non-zero timestamp, non-empty operations, and validates every individual op in the batch.

5. **v1 Events Migration and Deprecation ([`internal/core/ops/migrate.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/migrate.go), [`internal/core/events/doc.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/events/doc.go))**:
   - Implemented [`MigrateV1Events`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/ops/migrate.go#L13) to safely relocate `.memory/events/` to `.memory/archive/v1-events/`.
   - Annotated [`internal/core/events`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed42/internal/core/events/doc.go#L3) package documentation with `// Deprecated: use internal/core/ops instead. Will be removed in WO5.`.

   - Comprehensive test suite covering validation per op type (valid and invalid paths), batch validation, writer/reader round-trip, chronological iteration across months, incremental iteration (`IterateAfter`), commit cutoff resolution (`IterateBefore`), context cancellation, and v1 events migration.

Since exit tests in Step 5 run inside `${WORKTREE_DIR}`, any agent without explicit worktree synchronization will fail exit tests when running against a freshly branched worktree.
